notes.title: Very Minor Update II
notes.notes:
- Normalized diagonal movement (you won't go faster when moving diagonally)
- slight balance tweaks to enemy hp
- Improved the attract mode sequence

As always, thank you for your continued interest!

notes.title: New Year's Update
notes.notes:
"Yes, I am still alive."

Even though I'm pretty much done with this game (which I have said before), it is fun to add stuff to The Rush once and a while to supplement my other projects. Here's what this update brings...

- Rebalanced a number of boss attacks in regards to difficulty scaling and bullet speeds
- Added a new attack to the Stage 1 Boss to prevent graze milking
- Made Paylo drop a points capsule on death
- Reduced the time it takes for a weapon capsule to convert into a points capsule by 8 seconds
- Resprited Mr. Membrane
- Fixed a bug with the displayed achievement badges on the Arcade Mode select screen
- Added an achievement badge for the "Technical Monkey" achievement
- Added a "Slowdown" setting, which when enabled causes the game's fps to drop when many bullets and enemies are in play (off by default)
- Added a new achievement correlating to a secret in Stage 5

Thank you to anyone reading this, and to anybody who has stuck with The Rush!

notes.title: August 3 Very Minor Update
notes.notes:
- Boss health bars now display the unique boss name instead of simply "BOSS"
- Stage 5's visuals and terrain mapping were improved
- Some balance changes and fixes that nobody really care about

Sorry for the small size of this update, but I do feel very satisfied with the game in its current state and would prefer to work on other projects (at the moment). Thank you for your continued interest.

notes.title: Bug Squashing Update
notes.notes:
Here's what's going on this time:

- Fixed visual error when pausing during Stage 4
- Removed the ability for the Respawn Type and Bonus Life Threshold to be changed on the pause menu
- Gave the Stage 7 Boss more hp and an additional attack during its second phase
- Fixed various bugs related to Steam Achievements
- Updated info sidebar hud
- Added some tricky bonus capsules to a few stages
- Set default starting lives back to 5 (you're welcome!)
- Added a funny easter egg (source: bro trust me)

Thank you again for playing The Rush!

notes.title: Post Launch Minor Update
notes.notes:
This update includes...
[list]
[*]Bug fixes (particularly regarding boss I-frames and the Option Punch)
[*]More polish (just a couple of new sprites and animation tweaks)
[*]Audio fixes (the correct versions of certain stage themes will now play)
[/list]

Thank you for playing THE RUSH! I have a secret update in the works for those who actually like the game, but I wanted to get some bugs out of the way first...

notes.title: Release Version 1.0 Is Finally Here
notes.notes:
- More achievements, less glitches, and a better looking stage 3!
- Some random edits to stage 7
- Inner terrain now has proper collision!
- Sound effect mixing tweaks
- Ending theme
- that's all I can remember right now...

notes.title: Final Early Access Update
notes.notes: I am so close to release I can just taste it! This update adds an actual functioning ending, complete with (rather short) credits. Thanks to everybody who has been playing The Rush so far! Some bugs were also fixed, and new sounds were added among other minute changes. Once I do a bit more polishing and make more achievements I will take the game out of Early Access purgatory for good! Remember to voice any opinions you have on the game. I will definitely still update The Rush after release with both fixes and new content, so don't worry if you find some game-breaking bug...

notes.title: Second Wind Update
notes.notes:
A second playable ship is now fully functional! However, function and balance are two different things... Feel free to voice any balancing concerns regarding the second ship (or anything for that matter).

Additionally, Stage 2 got some visual improvements, and the game can technically be completed. I will add looping and credits in the very near future (I'm on break for a bit). Stage 8 has also been improved (?). Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Stability & Sanity Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bunch of crashes... sorry about those
- Added a new cutscene when game is started
- Minor balancing and enemy placement changes
- Recuperated my personal sanity a bit

Sorry to the 2 people who play for the general lack of updates as of recent. As it turns out, the final 10% of a game takes 5 times as long as the rest of the game, especially when time is hard to come by. Thank you to all players!

notes.title: Almost There (For Real) Update
notes.notes: Tons of little visual, audio, and gameplay tweaks/polish. I seriously don't have time to list all of the changes.... assuming I remember them. By the way, the final escape section is a stage now (which is basically done) because scope creep.

notes.title: Practice Makes Perfect Update
notes.notes:
As the name would suggest, the main feature if this update is a fully functioning practice mode to prepare yourself for that 1CC (which is still technically impossible by the way). Other notable changes include...

- The first two phases of the final boss are functional, but the game will crash after the second phase...
- Most bosses have some i-frames as they spawn for balancing purposes
- Stage 4 received a dramatic visual overhaul
- Option Punch has slightly reduced DPS
- Machine Gun has higher overall DPS
- Sound effect and mixing tweaks
- Back-end code improvements nobody cares about
- A new stage 3 theme (don't worry, the old one will come back)
- Nerfs to certain bosses at varying difficulty levels
- The 6th boss now drops a life as compensation for not having a weapon
- Visual improvements to tracking bullets
- Minor checkpoint alterations
- Sprite adjustments for increased visual clarity (such as subtle flashing for projectiles)

Thanks for your continued interest in The Rush!

notes.title: Almost There Update!
notes.notes:
This update has it all... except the final boss!
Some important changes include...
- Large buff to machine gun
- More sound effects!!!
- The final stage all the way up to where the last boss should be
- Typical polish and balance changes
- More forgiving checkpoints on difficulties under 1

Surely I forgot something...
but that is for you to find out!

notes.title: Nondescript Update
notes.notes:
- Fixed some issues with keyboard and controller inputs
- Expanded and tweaked stage 7
- Fixed some bugs
- Added a checkpoint to stage 2, but only on lower difficulties (more similar checkpoints will be added to other stages soon)
- Tweaked pause menu dialogue
- Nerfed Triple (just a hair)
- Other things I cannot remember right now

notes.title: September 23 Update
notes.notes:
I actually listed the changes as I made the update this time...

- Made D-Pads function correctly in game
- Made attract mode less intrusive
- Overhauled the menu system (start/shoot can progress menus, bomb moves back through menus)
- Added Training Mode (currently inaccessible)
- The escape key (when using keyboard) and the back/select button (when using controller) now quit the game when pressed
- Made Option Punch less random and fixed an oversight with its DPS
- Added stuff to the blank parts of the pause menu

Extra options may be added to arcade mode later depending on how much I want to feature creep the game.

notes.title: September 5 Update
notes.notes:
- More steam achievements added (a couple are still unobtainable, sorry)
- 5th Stage Boss (Captain Kidney) was slightly reworked, and will no longer glitch out of bounds
- A few bosses received total hit point nerfs
- The "Extend" weapon's tentacle was increased in length
- The final stage item layout was altered slightly
- Some background graphics were altered to improve visual clarity during 5th boss fight, and to make them look better overall

notes.title: Steam Support Update
notes.notes:
Here are all the new things I can remember off the top of my head...
- Added steam achievement support
- The game now pauses when you open the steam overlay (I think...)
- Balance changes
- Very slight length increase to final stage 

(Note that all the "hidden" achievements are not obtainable secrets, but rather nonfunctional achievements I have yet to entirely implement)

notes.title: Day 3(?) Patch
notes.notes: I literally have no time to write patch notes right now sorry~

notes.title: Day 2 Patch Update
notes.notes:
If you are reading this, thank you for taking interest my game! Here are the changes in this relatively small patch/update.
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when pausing under certain conditions
[*] Fixed bug where option menu music would not play (ever)
[*] Added visual improvements to stage 6
[*] Added stage intros to stages 3 and 6 (more are on the way)
[*] Fixed some code redundancy that doesn't really affect anything...
[*] Fixed bug where you could start with a machine gun weapon for free
[/list]
I will try to update the game whenever I can with more improvements and content, so stay tuned. I hope to get The Rush out of early access soon-ish...
